**Chevron's total revenue fell about 7.11% from Q1 2023 to Q4 2023**, taking "total revenue" to mean the company's "Total revenues and other income" line. These figures are from memory of the filings, not looked up here.

- Q1 2023: about $50,793 million
- Q4 2023: about $47,180 million (full-year total less the first three quarters)
- Change: (47,180 − 50,793) / 50,793 ≈ −7.11%

If you instead mean "Sales and other operating revenues" only, the figures are about $48,842 million and $48,933 million, a change of roughly +0.19%.
